startup: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund; fi; node {{STARTUP_FILE}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# AZURIFY WhatsApp bot install script
apt update
apt install -y curl unzip git

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -n "${ZIP_URL}" ]; then
  echo "Downloading the bot from ${ZIP_URL}"
  curl -fsSL "${ZIP_URL}" -o bot.zip
  unzip -o bot.zip
  rm -f bot.zip
else
  echo "No ZIP_URL set. Upload the bot files (package.json, index.js, src/) in the Files tab."
fi

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation complete"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Startup file
variables.description: The file Node.js runs to start the bot.

variables.name: Bot ZIP URL (optional)
variables.description: Optional direct link to a ZIP of the bot, downloaded and extracted on install. Leave empty to upload the files yourself.

variables.name: Panel URL
variables.description: AZURIFY panel address including its secret path, e.g. https://vpn.example.com:17024/abc123

variables.name: Panel API token
variables.description: Admin API token. Create it in the panel under Settings > Security > API tokens (Admin scope), or on the VPS run: /usr/local/azurify-ui/azurify-ui setting -getApiToken

variables.name: WhatsApp number
variables.description: Your number with country code, digits only (for example 94771234567). The console prints a pairing code for it. Leave empty to get a QR code instead.

variables.name: Extra admin numbers
variables.description: Comma separated numbers (digits only) that may also use commands. The linked number itself always can.

variables.name: Client portal URL (optional)
variables.description: Link sent to customers. Leave empty to use the panel address + /clientportal/

variables.name: Default data limit
variables.description: Used when .create has no data part. 0 = unlimited. Examples: 100gb, 50gb, 500mb

variables.name: Default expiry
variables.description: Used when .create has no expiry part. 0 = never. Examples: 30d, 2d, 1h, 1d12h
